data.title: HK Express passenger injured after power bank overheats on flight to Jeju
data.description: A traveller was injured after a power bank overheated and emitted smoke aboard an HK Express flight from Hong Kong to South Korea on Sunday, prompting crew members to deploy emergency safety measures before the aircraft landed safely.

data.title: US-brokered truce begins in Ukraine city occupied by Russia
data.description: KYIV, Ukraine - A truce between Ukraine and Russia aimed at allowing humanitarian aid into the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky entered into force early on Tuesday, having been announced by US First Lady Melania Trump last week.

data.title: Lula win rattles Brazil markets over spending spree fears
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO (BRAZIL) - The reelection of Brazilian leftist Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva rattled markets on Monday as investors, who had expected a win for his conservative rival, worried about fiscal discipline.

data.title: Brazilian lawmaker Andre Janones, Lula's social media 'general'
data.description: SAO PAULO - In Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's first victory speech, he praised "our general" Andre Janones, the brains behind the online campaign that ensured his stunning comeback.

data.title: Netanyahu, rivals trade attacks over Iran as clock counts down to Israel vote
data.description: JERUSALEM - Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu wrapped up his campaign to remain in power on Monday with a claim that Israel faced potential annihilation at the hands of Iran should his election rivals prevail.

data.title: Canadian youth seek climate action in landmark trial
data.description: VANCOUVER - Fifteen young Canadians will try to prove their nation's federal government has breached their rights through insufficient action on climate change in a landmark trial that has opened in the west coast city of Vancouver.

data.title: Trump blasts Norway over Nobel Peace Prize snub
data.description: PORT HURON — US President Donald Trump attacked Norway during a campaign rally, calling it a "shit house country," and said that Norwegian immigrants were not welcome in the United States because its Nobel Committee had not awarded him the Peace Prize.

data.title: Part of London's Oxford Street pedestrianised 'forever'
data.description: LONDON - A stretch of London's iconic Oxford Street was made traffic-free "forever" starting Monday, as pedestrians took over the country's most famous shopping street, absent of the capital's red double-decker buses and black cabs.

data.title: Houthis attack Saudi Arabia before high-stakes talks in Tehran
data.description: RIYADH — Yemen's Houthis have kept up their attacks on Saudi Arabia as senior officials from the kingdom, Turkey and Pakistan are due to hold high-stakes talks with Iran in Tehran on Monday, following warnings of a return to war.

data.title: Russia says open to lesser ceasefires with Ukraine, not end of war
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia said Monday that it would not slow down its offensive on Ukraine despite upcoming US-brokered talks on ending the conflict but that it could agree local "humanitarian" ceasefires.

data.title: Swedish Centre Party leader says government coalition talks failed
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Swedish Centre Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist on Monday said she had failed to form a government uniting left and right wing parties, leaving the Nordic country no closer to a new government after its September 13 election.

data.title: France's Macron to visit Marseille after protest violence
data.description: MARSEILLE (FRANCE) - The French government sought to draw a line Monday under weeks of protests that have been marred by violence, with President Emmanuel Macron headed to Marseille and the prime minister to meet with students demanding better school conditions.

data.title: Canada-EU summit seeks deepened alliance as US ties fray
data.description: MONTREAL (CANADA) - Canadian and European Union leaders meet in Montreal this week for a summit aimed at deepening their alliance as both sides navigate tumultuous relations with the United States.

data.title: China's Communist Party elite gather for key talks on governance
data.description: BEIJING - China's President Xi Jinping opened a key meeting of Communist Party elite in Beijing on Monday, state media said, which observers will be closely watching for clues as to the country's direction and future leadership.

data.title: AI-generated ad blitz distorts US midterms
data.description: WASHINGTON - The video looks hyper-real, depicting a US Senate candidate laughing at cards that read "Death to America" and "Celebrate 9/11". But it is part of a multimillion-dollar blitz of AI-generated political ads ahead of the midterm elections.

data.title: China's Communist Party elite gather for governance talks
data.description: BEIJING - China's President Xi Jinping and other top leaders meet in Beijing on Monday at a key gathering watched closely for clues as to the country's direction and future leadership.

data.title: 'I am here': Opposition leader Machado returns to Venezuela
data.description: GUACARA (VENEZUELA) - Maria Corina Machado, Venezuela's opposition leader and a Nobel Peace Prize winner, returned home on Sunday after nearly a year in exile, in a direct challenge to the US-backed interim government.

data.title: Flights resume at Riyadh airport as Houthis attack Saudi Arabia
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - Flights resumed at Riyadh's international airport on Sunday following a series of deadly attacks on the facility that saw it closed for two weeks, even as Yemen's Houthis targeted the country with strikes.

data.title: Aleksandar Vucic: Serbia's veteran ruler felled by student-led movement
data.description: BELGRADE - The dominant force in Serbian politics for over 14 years, Aleksandar Vucic, who conceded defeat in a snap parliamentary poll on Sunday, rose from the wreckage of strongman Slobodan Milosevic's cabinet to the centre of power using his brand of populist nationalism.

data.title: Storms batter Europe hitting power supplies, flights and phones
data.description: LONDON - Storms battered northern Europe Sunday cutting power to more than 150,000 homes, disrupting travel and phone networks.

data.title: Nigeria widens hunt for possible Ebola cases
data.description: ABUJA - Nigeria has widened a hunt for potential Ebola cases, with an additional nine contacts traced, health authorities said Sunday.

data.title: Shock and grief in a Jordanian village after church attack
data.description: HAMMOUD (JORDAN) - Workers were cleaning the last traces of blood from St George's Church in Jordan's Hammoud the day after a deadly attack, when visitors arrived to express their solidarity amid an atmosphere of shock and grief.

data.title: Ukraine war divides Bulgaria as voters elect president
data.description: SOFIA (BULGARIA) - Bulgarians were voting in a presidential election on Sunday, as security concerns swirl following a series of drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea.

data.title: UK PM calls for 'honest discussion' about EU free movement
data.description: LONDON - UK leader Andy Burnham indicated he was open to readopting the European Union's free movement rules as part of Britain's future relationship with the bloc, said a report published Sunday.

data.title: Far-right leader Le Pen kicks off tilt at French presidency amid nationwide protests
data.description: ORLéANS (FRANCE) - Marine Le Pen, France's far-right candidate to succeed President Emmanuel Macron in elections in six months, was to give her first campaign speech on Sunday, a day after protests sweeping the country again flared into violence.
